summary: Barings Private Credit Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Supplemental Indenture for a $350 million notes offering. The 6.500% notes due 2031 are general unsecured senior obligations, ranking pari passu with existing unsecured debt and structurally junior to subsidiary liabilities. Interest is payable semi-annually, with optional redemption and a change-of-control repurchase feature. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
